title: DC-area forecast: Cool and wet as fall begins; improvement late week
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Cloudy with plentiful light rain through evening, cool temperatures fairly steady in the upper 50s to low 60s, and breezy winds from the northeast. Fall officially begins this evening at 8:05 p.m.

What’s next? More rain tonight into at least early tomorrow. Cool highs mainly in the 60s continue through Thursday. Trending drier and somewhat warmer into the weekend.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Periods of rain persist overnight with cloudy skies and some fog possible. Winds stay breezy at 10 to 15 mph from the northeast with gusts up to 20 to 25 mph. Lows are in the mid- to upper 50s. Many areas could see another 0.25 to 0.75 inches of rain. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Wednesday): More periods of rain possible during the morning, then potentially trending drier during the afternoon, although light showers could linger at times. Continued cloudy and breezy – still some gusts from the northeast up near 25 mph – with highs in the upper 50s to mid-60s. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Cloudiness continues with the chance of a few showers, gusty breezes, and lows in the 50s. Confidence: Medium

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Thursday should still be under the influence of strong low pressure spinning offshore. That means partly cloudy skies, lingering breezy conditions, and cool highs in the mid- to upper 60s. A slight chance of a shower or sprinkle exists as well. Thursday night is breezy and cool with lows from the upper 40s in the outer suburbs to the low to mid-50s near and inside the Beltway. Confidence: Medium

Friday is a trickier forecast as some models keep sufficient cloud cover around to limit highs to the 60s again, while others bring in enough sunshine to lift us back to near 70 or the low 70s. For now, we'll go partly sunny with the mid-60s to near 70 for highs, and it may still be breezy. Friday night may see a few clouds with lows in the low to mid-50s. Confidence: Low-Medium

The final weekend of September is a little less clear than it was as low pressure may stick around or even wrap in closer to the shore for a time, potentially throwing some rain at eastern parts of the region Saturday. Weekend highs in the mid-60s to mid-70s. Saturday night could see clouds around with lows in the 50s. Confidence: Low-Medium

Next week probably leads us into October with warmer 70s, more sunshine, and less rain.

DC weather history for September 22

An unusually early chill in 1904 brought the first September temperatures in the 30s on record, while in 1994 a nor’easter delivered heavy rain, strong winds, and coastal damage.

Today’s daily digit — 5/10: Autumn's first notes are a soggy song, with our coolest weather since May. But hey, it's that old refrain that we need this rain! | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
